paite: Na unau bawngtal hiam, abelam hiam mang na muhleh na daihsan ding ahi kei. Na unau inn ah na pi ngeingei ding ahi.
Na unau inn kiangnai a om ahih louh a, aneimi na theih louh uh ahihleh, na inn ah na pitou dia, na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia, na unau in azon hunhun in na pe nawn ding ahi.

Huchi mah bang in asabiltung leng na hih ding ahi. Huai mah bang in apuansilh leng na hih ding ahi. Huchi mah bang in na unau thil mansak na muh peuhmah na hih ding ahi, na daihsan mawkmawk ding ahi kei.
Na unau sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, lampi a puk na muhleh na daihsan maimah ding ahi kei. Na photpih ngeingei ding ahi.
Numei in pasal van asilh ding ahi kei. Pasal in numei van asilh ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh huchibang hihmi TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in kihhuai ahi.
Lampi a vasabu, sing ah hiam, lei ah hiam, anou hiam, atui hiam om, anou hiam atui hiam, api in a-opkhum lai na muhleh api toh anou na lakkhawm ding ahi kei.
Api na khah ngeingei ding ahi. Anou bel na la thei ding ahi. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, na damsung na sawtsak ding hi.
Inn thak na lam chiang in atung a pan mi kia a, asisan moh na khuklouhna ding in atung na um ding ahi.
Na grephuan ah thil chi nih na ching ding ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na chi tuh gah leh na grephuan a gah teng siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Bawngtal leh sabiltung lei na kaikhawmsak ding ahi kei.
Samul leh pat kigankhawm puan na silh ding ahi kei.
Na kituamna puan uh agei li ah mong khih na bawl ding uh ahi.
Pasal khatpeuh in zi aneih a, akithuahpih a, amuhdah nawn thepthup a,
heading: Numei Pasal Kal Sianthouna Toh Kisai

paite: hiai numei ka kitenpih a, ka kithuahpih a, nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi a zahlaktak a bawl a, amin ahihsiatleh,
nungak nu leh pa'n kulh kongpi ah huai kho upate kiang ah nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate ahon tawi ding uhi.
Nungak pa'n upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipa ka tanu ka neisak a, aho nawn thepthup hi.

Ngai un, na tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi in zahlaktak in abawl a, himahleh hiaite ka tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ahi,” achi ding hi. Huchi in huai kho upate ma ah tua puan aphah ding hi.
Huai kho upate'n huai mipa paipih in agawt ding ua;
Israel nungak siangthou asukminsiat ziak in dangka shekel zakhat aliausak ding ua, nungak pa ape ding uhi; amah zi ahi dia, adamsung in akhen thei kei ding.
Himahleh huai mipa thu ana dik a, nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate muh ahihkeileh;

nungak pen apa'n kongpi ah apikhe dia, atenna khua a mite'n amah suang in adenglum ding uh; apa inn a kizuak a Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuai mahmah ahih ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan, huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Pasal khat in pasal nei numei akithuahpih lai muh ahihleh akithuahpih pasal leh numei anih ua asih ding uh ahi. Huchibang in Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Nungak siangthou, mi zikham, pasal khat in khopi a amuh a, akithuahpihleh;

anih un khokulh kongpi ah na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uh; numei pen khua a-om ngal a, akikou louh ziak in. Pasal pen a-invengte zi ahihminsiat ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Himahleh min gamlak a midang in zi dia akhamsa nungak amuh a, apawngsualleh hiai thilhih pasal kia sihsak ding ahi.
Nungak pen bangmah loh louh ding ahi. Nungak in sihna khop khelhna bangmah hih lou ahi. Hiai bang mi ahihleh min a-invengte sual a, that toh kibang ahi.
Hiai bang thu ahihleh gamlak a va tuak kha a, mi zikham nungak kikou a, panpih ding mi om lou ahih ziak ahi.
Mi'n nungak siangthou kuamah kham louh amuh a, amat a, akithuahpih amuh uleh;
akithuahpih pasal in nungak pa dangka shekel sawmnga ape ding ahi. Zi in anei ding ahi; ahihminsiat tak ziak in. Huchi in adamsung in akhen thei kei ding hi.
Pasal in apa zi akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apa lupna abuahsak ding ahi kei.
